title: Add Swagger/OpenAPI docs to thinkboard-backend and sync api.json

goals.description: Extend api/openapi.yaml to cover the real route surface (GET /healthz, GET /v1/me) including the bearer auth scheme, replacing the /healthz-only stub
Install a Swagger package (gin-swagger + swaggo/files) and wire a /swagger UI route into router.go serving openapi.yaml
Confirm api/api.json (Postman collection) still matches the current route surface; keep its existing Postman format per user decision (do not redefine as OpenAPI)
Add an integration test that signs in via Supabase Auth with admin@gmail.com/password and calls GET /v1/me end-to-end to validate the documented auth flow
